rule: One melee hit resolves on one animation frame (melee frame 2, bow frame 5), once per swing. If damage is above zero, in order: hit sound (random one of five weapon clips), one-shot blood billboard at 10 fps, knockback set from the closed form 40*d^2/(W+10d) clamped to 15..40 classic units (with a live-knock guard above 5 units), a 40 percent combat voice roll; then health is removed and the attacker hook runs. Knockback decays 5 classic units per classic update, enters the hurt state above 5 and re-evaluates the attack above 10. Death is deferred one update by a flag and then completes with a corpse marker and a body-fall clip. The player side has only a red full-screen flash (0.4 alpha, 0.7 per second fade). No hit-stop and no shake exist in the game code read.
keep: closed-form knockback from damage and victim weight, with min and max clamp

look_test: Hit ladder in the Pit: one dummy, damage 4, 8, 12, 20 at weights 100 and 350. Tap between A (donor set: sound, blood, knock), B (A plus 70 ms hit-stop and 3 px shake for 120 ms), C (B plus a 0.35 player flash for 180 ms and a short player knock). Judge whether damage 4 reads as a tap given the 15 floor, whether heavy weight feels heavy, and whether the stop helps a three-on-one fight.
